C1.原句: We cycled S@PAN||LMA half cells at the E/S ratio of 5 with excessive LMA and a sulfur loading of 2 mg cm2, where the current rate is 0.1 C (1 C = 1671 mA g1) during first seven cycles before the current rate was switched to 0.2 C for the rest of cycling.
C1.备注: 隔膜不同：HE-2 用 Celgard 2400，BE 用 Celgard 3501（为润湿性）

比较.溶剂化依据: FSRS Raman + AIMD：TFTFE 不参与 Li+ 溶剂化，FSI- 环境不变（同篇实验 + 模拟）

指标.原句: In sharp contrast, BE exhibited an initial discharge capacity of 952 mAh gs 1 with a lower Li-insertion potential (Figure 4b) compared to HE-2, probably due to the poor electrode wetting (Figure S5).

The discharge capacity with BE was consistently lower than HE-2 by 200 mAh g1 s , over cycling, where it delivered 407 mAh gs 1 at the 10th cycle and 386 mAh gs 1 at the 50th cycle, as shown in Figure 4c.
After conditioning at 0.1 C for 7 cycles, the HE-2 cell exhibited the discharge capacity of 603 mAh gs 1 and 598 mAh gs 1 at the 10th and 50th cycle, respectively
The initial and following discharge capacity values were significantly lower than both BE and HE-2, presumably due to the limited contact of Li+ and sulfur by over-dilution.

Initial plating/stripping overpotentials of BE were 54 mV and 45 mV, respectively, and the first CE was 93.7%, which gently increased to 97.7% by the 10th cycle, but it started to fluctuate during the following cycling.

指标.取值点: 第 30 圈（A）/ 第 10 圈后波动（B）
指标.原句: It gradually rose to 99.6% by the 30th cycle with a reduced overpotential of 25 mV and 25 mV upon plating and stripping, respectively.
As observed, BE displays a greater overpotential upon plating and stripping, i.e., 31 mV, than that of HE-2, 15 mV, at 0.5 mA cm2.

备注: 电解液比较用的是 S@PAN 正极 → 正极层应为 SPAN（非主层），B 步记为主层有误。CMK-3/S 硫碳正极和混合正极只测了 HE-2。A 全面占优（无权衡）；但 A、B 隔膜不同（混杂）。全电池（N/P 2、E/S 2–3）只测 HE-2。
